findings.location: Paragraph quoting Acts 17:24-25 (source.html second to last sentence of fourth paragraph)
findings.source_quote: —God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands; Neither is worshipped with men’s hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things; –Acts 17:24-25.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the verbs and clauses to convey the original meaning: God does not 'dwell' in temples made with hands and is not 'served' (or 'worshipped') with men's hands as if he needed anything. Replace the current phrasing with a natural Kiswahili rendering that preserves those meanings. For example: «—Mungu aliyeumba dunia na vitu vyote vilivyo ndani yake; kwa kuwa yeye ndiye Bwana wa mbingu na dunia, hafanyi makazi ndani ya madhabahu yaliyojengwa kwa mikono; wala haisifiwi kwa mikono ya watu, kana kwamba anahitaji kitu chochote; kwa maana yeye ndiye anayewapa wote uhai, pumzi, na vitu vyote. – Matendo 17:24-25.»
findings.translation_quote: —Mungu ambaye aliumba dunia na vitu vyote vilivyo ndani yake; kwa kuwa yeye ndiye Bwana wa mbingu na dunia, hafaili kuishi katika madhabahu yaliyojengwa kwa mikono; wala haisifiwi kwa mikono ya watu, kana kwamba anahitaji kitu chochote; kwa maana yeye ndiye anayewapa wote uhai, pumzi, na vitu vyote; – Matendo 17:24-25.

The current rendering contains a nonstandard/incorrect verb ('alikulikwa msalabani'). Use a standard phrasing such as: "Kwa walioangalia, ilionekana kuwa Shetani alikuwa na nguvu kabisa wakati Yesu alipomalishwa msalabani na kuzikwa." or "... wakati Yesu aliposalibishwa na kuzikwa."
